day=1; meal=chicken nuggets; setting=Personal; time_of_day=evening;
preferences: microwave_time=2 min; robot_speed=medium; skewering_axis=perpendicular to major axis; confirm_feeding_pickup=yes (with auto-continue countdown); confirm_navigation_arrival=yes (with auto-continue countdown); confirm_manipulation=yes (with auto-continue countdown); transfer_mode=outside mouth transfer; outside_mouth_distance=near; convey_robot_ready_for_initiating_transfer=speech + LED; detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfer_feeding=open mouth; detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfer_drinking=open mouth; detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfer_wiping=open mouth; convey_robot_ready_for_completing_transfer=speech + LED; detect_user_completed_transfer_feeding=perception; detect_user_completed_transfer_drinking=perception; detect_user_completed_transfer_wiping=button; retract_between_bites=no; bite_dipping_preference=do not dip; bite_ordering=no particular order; wait_before_autocontinue_task_selection=no autocontinue; wait_before_autocontinue_feeding_pickup=no autocontinue; wait_before_autocontinue_mealprep=60 sec

microwave_time.user_tendencies: IF meal is a hot/savory item like chicken nuggets THEN 2 min BECAUSE user prefers warm food; cold desserts or fruits would use no microwave. No further variation observed yet.

skewering_axis.user_tendencies: User can open mouth wide, so perpendicular skewering for higher acquisition success is acceptable. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

confirm_feeding_pickup.user_tendencies: User keeps confirmation on but with auto-continue in a personal setting, suggesting moderate trust with a safety net. May tighten toward explicit confirmation in social settings to avoid awkward failed transfers, but no direct evidence yet.

confirm_navigation_arrival.user_tendencies: User keeps meal-prep checks on with auto-continue, indicating a still-calibrating trust level. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

confirm_manipulation.user_tendencies: User keeps manipulation checks on with auto-continue, consistent with cautious-but-not-blocking style during prep. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

transfer_mode.user_tendencies: User can lean forward and deployment only performs outside-mouth transfer; predict inside only if explicitly requested. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

outside_mouth_distance.user_tendencies: User is comfortable with the robot close to the mouth in a personal setting. May stay near or move closer when fatigued; no evidence of preferring farther yet.

convey_robot_ready_for_initiating_transf.user_tendencies: User prefers rich multimodal cues. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfe.user_tendencies: In personal settings user uses open-mouth detection. In social settings user may switch to button to avoid confusion with talking (physical ability supports button); however IF fatigued THEN prefer open mouth to reduce effort — effort-minimization wins under fatigue. No direct social/fatigue evidence yet.
Same pattern as feeding: open mouth in personal settings, likely button in social settings unless fatigued (then open mouth). No direct evidence yet.
Same pattern as feeding: open mouth in personal settings, likely button in social settings unless fatigued. No direct evidence yet.

convey_robot_ready_for_completing_transf.user_tendencies: User prefers rich multimodal cues. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

detect_user_completed_transfer_feeding.user_tendencies: User prefers reliable automatic perception for bite completion. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

detect_user_completed_transfer_drinking.user_tendencies: User accepts head-nod perception for sip completion in personal settings; head gestures may feel unnatural socially and could shift to button, but no social evidence yet.

detect_user_completed_transfer_wiping.user_tendencies: User chose button for wipe completion (able to press buttons), differing from perception used for feeding/drinking. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

retract_between_bites.user_tendencies: In personal settings user skips retracting to save time. May prefer retracting in social/TV/working settings to avoid obstructing view, but no such evidence yet.

bite_dipping_preference.user_tendencies: User did not dip for chicken nuggets in a personal setting. If a meal includes dips/sauces this may change; less dipping likely in social settings to avoid messiness. No direct dipping evidence yet.

bite_ordering.user_tendencies: No ordering or pairing preference observed yet.

wait_before_autocontinue_task_selection.user_tendencies: User prefers the between-tasks page to wait for explicit selection, indicating they dislike being rushed and want control over pacing. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

wait_before_autocontinue_feeding_pickup.user_tendencies: User wants pickup/bite-selection pages to wait indefinitely for explicit input, consistent with wanting control over each bite. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

wait_before_autocontinue_mealprep.user_tendencies: User allows a long wait on meal-prep check pages, giving ample time to intervene while still auto-continuing. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

plate_color_fridge.user_tendencies: No color-correction evidence yet; using neutral seed with moderate tolerance.
